rules.name: recon-refresh-cfs-verify-uat
rules.sql: WITH ptr AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_run_id FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = 'CFS' AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p2.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p2 WHERE p2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p2.business_unit = p.business_unit AND p2.view_type = p.view_type) ) SELECT p.view_type, p.settlement_date, count(s.uuid) AS row_count, count(s.source_trade_id) AS has_source_trade_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.trade_id = s.source_trade_id || '-CFS') AS suffix_ok, count(s.nc_factor) AS has_nc_factor FROM ptr p JOIN opera.recon_settle_snapshot s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id WHERE p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' GROUP BY p.view_type, p.settlement_date UNION ALL SELECT p.view_type, p.settlement_date, count(s.uuid), count(s.source_trade_id), count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.trade_id = s.source_trade_id || '-CFS'), NULL::bigint FROM ptr p JOIN opera.recon_actual_snapshot s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id WHERE p.view_type = 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' GROUP BY p.view_type, p.settlement_date UNION ALL SELECT p.view_type, p.settlement_date, count(s.uuid), count(s.source_trade_id), count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.trade_id = s.source_trade_id || '-CFS'), NULL::bigint FROM ptr p JOIN opera.recon_traders_snapshot s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id WHERE p.view_type = 'TRADERS_PRICING' GROUP BY p.view_type, p.settlement_date ORDER BY 1

WITH d AS ( SELECT max(settlement_date) AS settlement_date FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' ), pick AS ( SELECT h.subportfolio FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h, d WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit = 'CFS' AND h.settlement_date = d.settlement_date GROUP BY h.subportfolio HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 100 AND 2000 ORDER BY (h.subportfolio = 'RMS-DF-LIF-OIR') DESC, h.subportfolio LIMIT 1 ) SELECT (SELECT subportfolio FROM pick) AS subportfolio, count(*) AS view_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.source_trade_id IS NULL) AS source_trade_id_null, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.mtm_usd IS NULL) AS mtm_usd_null, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.mtm_usd IS NULL AND v.mtm_nc IS NOT NULL AND v.nc_factor IS NOT NULL AND v.fx_nc_factor IS NOT NULL) AS mtm_usd_null_with_factors, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.mtm_usd IS NOT NULL AND v.mtm_nc IS NOT NULL AND v.nc_factor IS NOT NULL AND v.fx_nc_factor IS NOT NULL AND abs(v.mtm_usd - v.mtm_nc * v.nc_factor * v.fx_nc_factor) > 0.01 + 0.000000001 * abs(v.mtm_usd)) AS mtm_usd_not_equal_product FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view v, d WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = 'CFS' AND v.settlement_date = d.settlement_date AND v.subportfolio = (SELECT subportfolio FROM pick)

expect.reason: every row of the latest published CFS snapshots has source_trade_id
trade_id is exactly source_trade_id plus the CFS suffix
the settle snapshot has stored nc_factor values
the consumer view returns rows for the subportfolio
the consumer view exposes source_trade_id (view v4 is applied)
mtm_usd is never NULL when mtm_nc, nc_factor and fx_nc_factor are present
mtm_usd equals mtm_nc times nc_factor times fx_nc_factor
